title: SFTP repository unit tests cannot construct the repository after canonical SQL pack externalization
environment: Java 25.0.3; Gradle 9.1.0; one worker; local profile
actualResult: 3 tests executed and 3 failed before assertions
actualError: IllegalStateException: cpf.db.resource-root is required; module-local Vendor SQL fallback is unsupported
rootCause: The SQL catalog correctly became an external fail-closed runtime dependency, but JdbcCpfFileTransferRepository offers only constructors that construct that environment-owned dependency internally. Its isolated repository tests therefore cannot inject the contract they are testing against.
repairPolicy: Add explicit CpfVendorSqlCatalog dependency injection while retaining existing fail-closed environment constructors; inject a strict statement catalog in repository unit tests. Actual external query-pack existence and DB execution remain separate mandatory gates.
sourceFix: A null-safe explicit CpfVendorSqlCatalog constructor now owns dependency injection; both existing environment constructors delegate through it and retain fail-closed external resource resolution. Unit tests inject only statement lookup while retaining the real JDBC repository behavior.
verification: Java 25 Gradle 9.1 exact replay passes 3/3 tests with zero failures/errors in 19 seconds; 47 actionable tasks with 3 executed and one worker. The separate three-vendor Backoffice runtime pack inventory also passes with 176 files per vendor.
passCriteria: Exact 3 repository tests PASS under Java 25
Default runtime constructor remains fail-closed without cpf.db.resource-root
External Backoffice query-pack gates are not skipped
